name.en: Right anterior-eye layer study · not whole eye
name.zh: 右眼前节分层研究·非完整眼球

technical.scope: Finite source-preserving accessor/container checks only: all selected POSITION/index bytes and local transforms identical to raw source; normals finite; indices in range; all four variants reproduce byte-identically in fresh directory. Not watertightness or self-intersection pass.

visual.scope: STATIC LAYER-STUDY READABILITY ONLY. Root personally inspected exact-export multiview/layers, lens comparison, cornea source-normal comparison, and ghost-sclera context. Explicitly not a polished whole-eye/exterior pass.

anatomy.scope: Primary educational diagrams support only broad cornea–iris–lens order and ciliary-ring context; actual source mesh identity crosschecked. Exact insertions, thickness, source morphology, anatomical completeness and clinical truth are unverified.

runtime.scope: Blender 4.3.2 Cycles static exact-GLB reimports only. No intended browser/viewer playback, layer UI, motion or optical runtime verified.
